newsAll.head: Justin Jefferson: Not practicing, day-to-day
newsAll.body: Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell said that Jefferson (ankle) won't practice Wednesday and is viewed as day-to-day.

newsAll.head: Nico Collins: Practicing Wednesday
newsAll.body: Collins (hamstring) returned to practice Wednesday, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

newsAll.head: Jalen Coker: Working on side field Wednesday
newsAll.body: Coker (quadriceps) was present at Wednesday's practice with a helmet but spent the team stretch on a side field, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.

newsAll.head: Caleb Douglas: Misses practice Wednesday
newsAll.body: Dolphins head coach Jeff Hafley said that Douglas (ankle) won't practice Wednesday, Travis Wingfield of the team's official site reports.

newsAll.head: Jaylen Wright: Taking part in practice Wednesday
newsAll.body: Dolphins head coach Jeff Hafley said that Wright (foot/stinger) will practice Wednesday, C. Isaiah Smalls II of the Miami Herald reports.
